title: BTS sweeps MTV awards with Lisa taking best pop

blocks.text: K-pop artists walked away with several major trophies at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards in the US on Sunday, led by BTS’ three-award sweep and Blackpink member Lisa’s win in the best pop category. BTS won all three categories in which it was nominated — song of the year, best K-pop and best group — despite not attending the ceremony at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles.
